name: neocore
description: One memory for every AI harness you use. NeoCore keeps a local, dated memory of your Codex, Claude Code, Hermes and other AI sessions and lets Codex search it, open it and add to it.

interface.longDescription:
NeoCore is free, open-source (Apache-2.0) memory shared by the AI harnesses you use: Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI and opencode. It keeps every conversation turn on your own machine (or your own memory server), forms dated facts from it, and recalls the excerpts a prompt needs with zero model calls at recall.

With this plugin Codex can: search your past conversations and facts across every harness, open the full turn behind a result, check what was true on a given date, and save something you ask it to remember.

Who it is for: developers who work across several AI tools and are tired of re-explaining their projects, decisions and setup.

Limits: NeoCore runs locally, so this is a desktop-only plugin. It needs the open-source neocore-memory package (Python 3.10+); the get-started skill installs it with your permission and shows every file it will change first. Your memory stays on your machine or your own memory server. Facts are written by an AI tool you already use, and nothing is sent to NeoCore's developers unless you opt in to help train its relevance filter.
capabilities: Open the full turn behind a memory
Check what was true on a date
Remember something you ask it to
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about this project last week?
Search my memory for the deploy steps
Remember that staging deploys go out on Fridays

review.commerce_description: NeoCore is free and open source. It sells nothing and processes no payments.
